title: ‘Ted Lasso’ Returns for Season 4: How to Watch the Comeback Online for Free
summary: Jason Sudeikis’ beloved coach is back on the sidelines Aug. 5, this time leading a women’s soccer team.
contentText:

Three years after fans said goodbye to AFC Richmond, Ted Lasso is making a surprise comeback. The Emmy-winning Apple TV series returns Aug. 5 with Jason Sudeikis back as the beloved coach , but this time he’s taking on a new challenge: leading a women’s soccer team.

After Season 3 appeared to mark the end of Ted’s journey as he returned home to Kansas, the feel-good comedy is officially back with 10 new episodes. Alongside Sudeikis, familiar faces including Hannah Waddingham, Brett Goldstein, Juno Temple, Brendan Hunt and Jeremy Swift are returning for the next chapter.

The series became a streaming sensation during its original run, earning 13 Emmy Awards and becoming one of Apple TV’s most watched original shows. Now, fans can return to the world of Ted, Rebecca, Roy and the rest of the team when Season 4 premieres.

When Does ‘Ted Lasso’ Season 4 premiere?

Ted Lasso Season 4 will stream exclusively on Apple TV (formerly Apple TV+), meaning fans will need a subscription to watch Ted’s return to the pitch. The 10-episode season will release one new episode every Wednesday through the finale on Oct. 7.

For those looking to catch up before Season 4 arrives, all three previous seasons are currently available to stream on Apple TV, giving fans plenty of time to revisit AFC Richmond, Ted, Rebecca, Roy and Keeley before the new episodes premiere.

‘Ted Lasso’ Season 4 Synopsis & Cast

Season 4 picks up three years after many fans thought Ted Lasso’s story had come to an end, with Jason Sudeikis returning as the endlessly optimistic coach for an unexpected new chapter. This time, Ted heads back to Richmond to coach a second-division women’s football team, taking on what the series describes as his biggest challenge yet.

Alongside Sudeikis, the new season reunites fan favorites Hannah Waddingham, Brett Goldstein, Juno Temple, Brendan Hunt and Jeremy Swift. Season 4 also introduces several newcomers, including Tanya Reynolds, Jude Mack, Faye Marsay, Rex Hayes, Aisling Sharkey, Abbie Hern and Grant Feely.

Ted Lasso Season 4 premieres exclusively on Apple TV on Wednesday, Aug. 5, with new episodes dropping every Wednesday through the season finale on Oct. 7. Watch the official trailer below .
